To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have developed an efficient LOR‐based 3D Osem reconstruction algorithm for a 3D PET scanner that has 85 millions LORs, that we have implemented this algorithm on a Tesla GPU, and that we have obtained reconstruction times that are compatible with a real time clinical use.
the line‐of‐resolution (LOR‐based) 3D Osem (ordered subsets expectation maximization) algorithm was successfully implemented using a graphics processing unit (GPU).
the LOR‐based 3D Osem algorithm was successfully implemented and accelerated using a GPU.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the implementation of the LOR‐based 3D Osem PET algorithm on modern GPU devices.
the development of an efficient GPU‐based implementation of a LOR‐OSEMsolution for PET reconstruction.
the development of new algorithms for PET reconstruction that are able to exploit the high computational performance of modern GPUs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
GPU computing is a promising approach for PET image reconstruction.
the GPU is a low‐cost solution for advanced PET reconstructions.
this work shows that the LOR‐based OSEM algorithm, with or without attenuation and normalization corrections, can be efficiently implemented in a clinical setting using modern GPU devices.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the NVIDIA Tesla GPU is a very powerful device for PET image reconstruction.
the GPU is an efficient platform for the LOR‐based 3D Osem reconstruction.
a high performance computing solution for PET reconstruction is available and can be used for clinical purposes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the NVIDIA GPU device provides an attractive alternative for PET reconstruction.
the NVIDIA GPU device can be used as an accelerator for advanced PET reconstruction algorithms.
the LOR‐based OSEM algorithm is a viable alternative to the standard OSEM algorithm for PET reconstruction.
